extracted.summary: A family solicitor seeks around £25,500 to fund her client's costs to final hearing in financial remedy proceedings at the Central Family Court, where matrimonial assets are about £117,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and details, a breakdown of the estimated costs to final hearing, and documentary evidence of the matrimonial assets and any existing charges over them. It would also help to have an indication of your client's position on the proceedings and the date of the FDR listing confirmed in writing. Once we have reviewed that material a member of the team will come back to you. Please do let us know if any further information becomes available in the meantime.
